I28 case 5 · Three wrapping cards

Built from the responsive primitives that matter.

Each card is literal, self-contained, and long enough to demonstrate predictable text wrapping without any backend data or runtime binding.

Fluid by default

Fill sizing and an explicit maximum keep the page spacious on wide screens and calm when the viewport narrows.

Rows respond to the space available because their children declare honest minimum widths and consistent gaps.

Align to Parent makes the overlap deliberate, while the nested fixed canvas preserves precise local coordinates.
